name: ytzero-enhance
description: Make YT Zero better with smoother playback, smart link handling, and more control over every video.

scripts.check: bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test && bun scripts/build.ts --check
scripts.safari:project: bun run build && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location safari --app-name 'YT Zero Enhance' --bundle-identifier pl.pelski.ytzero-enhance --swift --copy-resources --no-open --no-prompt --force
